meta.siteDescription: Ti Mango, contemporary Creole restaurant in Sainte-Anne, Guadeloupe: homemade cooking with fresh, local produce. Menu, opening hours and online booking.

common.hoursLine: Tuesday to Sunday, 11:30am – 10pm · closed on Mondays
common.alcohol: L'abus d'alcool est dangereux pour la santé, à consommer avec modération. (Alcohol abuse is dangerous for your health; drink responsibly.)

home.title: Contemporary Creole restaurant in Sainte-Anne
home.lead: Homemade cooking rooted in traditional Caribbean recipes and fresh produce from the island, carefully served.
home.restaurantText: Ti Mango takes a modern approach to traditional Caribbean cooking: everything is made in-house from fresh, local produce, and every plate is carefully presented.
home.bookText: Online, in a minute. For groups of more than 8, please call us.

menu.title: Menu
menu.intro: Homemade cooking, fresh and local produce. Prices in euros, service included.

restaurant.title: The restaurant
restaurant.lead: Ti Mango revisits traditional Caribbean cooking with a modern approach, careful presentation and fresh produce.
restaurant.concept: Creole recipes are the starting point. Everything is cooked on site, from fresh and, wherever possible, local produce.
restaurant.place: 42 seats, at 12 rue de la Plage in Sainte-Anne.
restaurant.storyTodo: The restaurant's story, the chef, where the produce comes from.
